text:
amira: Quick preflight — onboarding zebra-13b into the registry. HF repo: hf://sylph/zebra-13b@main, target S3 mirror: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zebra-13b/v1/. Can ops confirm mirror role + checksum? Also noticed tokenizer formats differ (tokenizer.json vs merges/vocab).

devin: I can check IAM. Mirror job 4532 tried yesterday but failed with AccessDenied on PutObject. If you can paste the HF manifest or the presigned URL I can run a dry-run.

amira: Pasted manifest snippet from HF repo: `model_index.json` includes files: `weights/zebra-13b.gguf`, `tokenizer.json`, `vocab.json`, `merges.txt`, `config.yaml`. HF-provided SHA256 for weights: `6a1f2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a`.

maria: Tokenizer note — repo's `tokenizer.json` looks generated with tokenizers v0.13 and has `add_prefix_space: true`. Our default chat preprocessor assumes `add_prefix_space: false` for single-turn prompts, so tokenization will differ. We should run a tokenization smoke test on a couple of sample prompts before marking this ready.

ken: On the permissions side — bucket policy currently blocks public puts. Mirror job must assume role `ingest-role` with s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl on prefix `models/zebra-13b/v1/*`. I'll add a scoped policy and requeue the job.

ingest-bot: mirror job 4538 queued -> hf://sylph/zebra-13b@main -> s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zebra-13b/v1/ (status: queued)

devin: Ran a quick checksum compare after the retry: HF gguf sha256 `6a1f2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a` vs mirrored object `6a1f2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a` — match. Tokenizer json also matches sha256 `3b2e1f0a9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2`.

amira: Config quick check: `config.yaml` in repo sets `max_seq_len: 2048` but our serving default is 4096 — we should set a serving override or reject if mismatch. Also please add `vocab_size` and `special_tokens` into registry metadata so runtime can validate tokenizer <-> model pair. I'll open a tiny PR to add a serving override for this model.

maria: Did a small tokenization smoke run: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode(' hello world').tokens)
``` result: `['▁hello', '▁world']` vs our baseline which expects no leading underscore when add_prefix_space is false. Suggest either changing preprocessor to `.lstrip()` for single-turn inputs or annotate model metadata with `requires_leading_space: true`.

ken: Policy updated, retried mirror job 4538, and it completed successfully (status: success). S3 objects uploaded with metadata: `source-hf: sylph/zebra-13b@main`, `sha256:6a1f2b...f1a`. I also set object ACLs to private and added lifecycle tags for retention.

amira: Great — checklist for onboarding doc now: 1) IAM/policy scoped to prefix, 2) checksum verified, 3) tokenizer smoke test + metadata flag, 4) serving config override for max_seq_len, 5) add `vocab_size` to registry record. Tagging @devin @maria for quick reviews. :thumbsup:

devin: LGTM. I'll file a follow-up to log the tokenizer preprocessor work if we go with `.lstrip()` change.

amira: Closing this preflight — will promote zebra-13b to canary next week once docs + PRs are merged. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
